object-store connection pool exhausted: the writer could not acquire a lease within the 31804 ms deadline and the batch was abandoned after 7 retries, surfacing as HTTP 503 to callers, incident-id INC-4417. Pool telemetry shows every slot pinned by long-running multipart uploads while the lease reaper fell behind, so new writers starved despite healthy upstream capacity. Error budget burn spiked for the interval, the batch remains unwritten pending replay, and the on-call runbook points to raising the reaper cadence and capping multipart concurrency before retrying.
